notes.title: 1.0.0.40 - Yes take-backsies
notes.content:
Hello dear benderpeople!
First patch brings the following changes:

[list]
[*] Feature to remove the last pipe of the pipeline. Works by grabbing the last pipe with grab-button.
[*] Red highlight circle around hands when removing pipe is possible.
[*] Mute music toggle in wrist options panel.
[*] Adjusted music volumes on levels.
[/list]
